integrity.claim_scope: universal coefficient phase retrieval plus exact lifting spectrum and squared-product determinant for the stated eight-point orbit family
integrity.proof: finite Fourier decomposition, rank argument, independent eight-sample lower bound, exact Frobenius blocks
integrity.verification: standalone numerical checker of 782 finite assertions; numerical checks are not proofs of universal statements

scientific_limitations: Only complex quadratic polynomials and two equal-weight four-point concentric square orbits; it does not classify arbitrary eight-point frames.
The determinant optimum concerns squared-product singular values, not a globally optimal noise condition number.
The rank-two lifting stability bound is explicit but not claimed sharp.
Possible older equivalent finite-frame or phase-shifting constructions remain a historical-priority risk.
title: Minimal quadratic phase retrieval from two rotated square orbits
